summary: Maintain published work and mission ordering by changed keys and expose per-list row reduction counts

rules.detail: Existing semantic changed-key plans, projection repair and eligibility deadlines remain authoritative.

compatibility.detail: The performance endpoint adds published_list_work with cumulative work, missions and runtimes refolded counters. Initial folds and catch-up chunks count every reduced key; unrelated commits count zero.

recovery.detail: Publication failure, withdrawal and rebuild behavior is unchanged.
